notes.title: Release 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Y-AXIS Inversion - now you can change the y-axis in the pause menu.

Fixed an issue with the wrong image displayed in Waltes game.

Fixed an issue where it was possible to get stuck in the water from level one side mission.

Updated and improved spawn points in level two.

Improved character camera orbit controls.

Stability fixes for handling of magical abilities across levels.

Fixed an issue where the character sound may glitch if the player got stuck between objects.

General performance and stability improvements.

notes.title: Release 1.0.1 Notes: Patches, Bug Fixes, and Reliability Improvements:
notes.notes:
Pause Menu - Mouse/Keyboard
Players using mouse/keyboard could lose their cursor in the pause menu if they click away from the menu buttons too many times. 
STATUS: FIXED

Tutorial Progress Skip
In rare occasions, the tutorial would skip a sequence, displaying the next objective. 
STATUS: FIXED

3D Sound and Attenuation
Some players were reporting attenuation on the 3D sounds can be out of sync or distracting.
STATUS: FIXED‍‍
